fields.objection: 029 overpredicted a different steel/PVC hemisphere by about 10% linearly and 2.31–2.46 times at imperfect nonlinear endpoints. Adding face plasticity does not itself establish a matched benchmark. CHECK-029 independently identifies the nonlinear benchmark gap as a StVK foam-law/core-refinement artifact; its linear-radius explanation is still unestablished.
fields.proposed_fix: Reproduce the complete benchmark constitutive, geometric and solution definitions, then validate a relevant low-Vc Be/CR-III test. Treat transferred ratios as conditional scenarios.
